title: [Bug 647233] Fix User Confirmed copied into Canceled when posting expense report lines
summary: Fixed a data corruption bug where the User Confirmed field from expense report lines was being incorrectly copied into the Canceled field of posted expense report lines during posting, by introducing a new non-colliding field and adding data migration logic.
key_points: The Canceled field in Posted Expense Report Line had the same field number (92) as User Confirmed in Expense Report Line, causing silent data corruption via TransferFields mapping
Field 92 (Canceled) was obsoleted and replaced with new field 94 (Is Canceled) to eliminate the collision
Upgrade logic was added to migrate existing data from the old field 92 to a temporary storage field 999 during module upgrade
The Cancel Posted Expense Report codeunit was updated to use the new Is Canceled field
Regression tests were added to prevent this issue from recurring
